name: IECC/Building America climate zone by U.S. county, 2021 code cycle
description: Which IECC climate zone (1-8, with A/B/C moisture regime) and which DOE Building America climate zone each U.S. county falls in under the 2021 code cycle, and whether that county's designation changed from the pre-2021 (2018 IECC) map. Answers 'what climate zone is my county in for insulation R-value and HVAC-sizing purposes' and 'did my county's zone change in the 2021 code' -- both load-bearing for code-compliance software, HVAC equipment sizing, and DOE Zero Energy Ready Home certification, and both wrong if answered from a pre-2021 map or a general knowledge cutoff. Source is a single DOE/Pacific Northwest National Laboratory report (PNNL-33270, Sept 2022) that prints one table row per county -- the free public proxy for ASHRAE Standard 169 Table B-1, which is paywalled. No free site was found that republishes PNNL's full, current, cited county table as clean HTML; the closest match (a GitHub gist CSV) carries no source citation or edition statement.
licence: US government work (DOE / Pacific Northwest National Laboratory, operated by Battelle for DOE under contract DE-AC05-76RL01830) -- public domain. Facts taken with short attributed quotes linking back to the published report.
